E5-01.why: alternates bracket the error on a pronoun axis (its / their / that) — three alternates vary one pronoun, so the item is a pronoun-number test and the singular possessive 'its' is the default key. Which of the four the stem's original is stays invisible, so partly a guess.

E5-02.why: elimination among alternates: A joins with a comma before an independent clause (splice), D differs from B only in tense and so reads as the tense-singleton distractor, leaving B as the clean semicolon + present.

E5-03.why: A (absolute phrase) and B (coordinated clause) are both defensible in isolation, so neither can be the unique key; between the remaining C and NO CHANGE the dash appositive is the concise ACT-preferred form. Half guess.

E5-04.why: redundancy ladder — 'unused and untouched' and 'unused and unplayed' are both doublets of the same idea and the ladder terminates at the bare 'unused'; concision residue decides it with no source.

E5-05.why: conjunction-logic axis: 'and' and the semicolon are semantically equivalent joins so neither can be uniquely correct, leaving 'but' as the only option supplying a relation the others cannot.

E5-06.why: C is a comma splice around a conjunctive adverb and is out on punctuation; B and D then differ only in however/therefore, and 'however' is the singleton adverb while 'therefore' appears twice — the option-set alone decides it.

E5-07.why: tense singleton — three alternates sit on a tense axis (past perfect / future / simple past) and simple past is the unmarked narrative default; NO CHANGE cannot also be 'was' or D would duplicate it.

E5-08.why: strike-on-sight: 'being' kills B, and C is a comma splice; the remaining distractor trio (being-participle, splice, and-coordination) is the standard cast built around an appositive key, which puts the key on NO CHANGE. Residue reasoning, so partly a guess.

E5-09.why: only one option punctuates two independent clauses legally — B is a comma splice, C puts a fragment before the colon, so the semicolon in D is the residue.

E5-10.why: elimination-to-the-residue on NO CHANGE: D drops the nonrestrictive commas, C swaps the subjunctive 'be' for indicative 'is', A is a number singleton ('honors'), leaving NO CHANGE. Guess to the extent the residue may be an artifact.
